unit_attributes.scope_text: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section.
unit_attributes.choice_text: (1) When performance has begun of the inspection of the individual's person or accessible property before entering a sterile area, or before boarding an aircraft for which screening is conducted under this subchapter; (2) When the individual is entering or in a sterile area; or (3) When the individual is attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.statement: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 1540.111, an individual may not have a weapon, explosive, or incendiary, on or about the individual's person or accessible property when performance has begun of the inspection before entering a sterile area or before boarding a screened aircraft, when entering or in a sterile area, or when attempting to board or onboard an aircraft for which screening is conducted under §§ 1544.201, 1546.201, or 1562.23.

unit_attributes.scope_text: As to carriage of firearms and other weapons on an individual's person or accessible property.
unit_attributes.choice_text: (1) Law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while in the performance of law enforcement duty at the airport; (2) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in accordance with §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562 of this chapter; or (3) An individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.
unit_attributes.statement: Paragraph (a) of 49 CFR 1540.111 does not apply to the carriage of firearms and other weapons if the individual is law enforcement personnel required to carry a firearm or other weapons while performing duty at the airport, an individual authorized to carry a weapon under §§ 1544.219, 1544.221, 1544.223, 1546.211, or subpart B of part 1562, or an individual authorized to carry a weapon in a sterile area under a security program.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any loaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter.

unit_attributes.scope_text: In checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter, unless the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, either orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded, and the firearm is unloaded.
unit_attributes.statement: A passenger may not transport or offer for transport any unloaded firearm(s) in checked baggage or in baggage carried in an inaccessible cargo hold under § 1562.23 of this chapter unless the passenger declares to the aircraft operator, orally or in writing, before checking the baggage, that the passenger has a firearm in his or her bag and that it is unloaded, and the firearm is unloaded.
